candidate_relations.rationale: The production-invocation contract's fixed evidence set and prohibition on authority inference strengthen the Distiller entrypoint's explicit closed ingestion-source typing.
The production-invocation contract's fixed evidence and no-autonomous-search boundary strengthens the distillation-ingestion operation's bounded evidence-selection behavior.
The project-identity amendment's exact v1 compatibility and explicit complete-v2 migration rule strengthens the bootstrap-runtime proposition describing the same migration boundary.
The project-identity amendment's preserved v1 compatibility and explicit v2 migration strengthen the project-bootstrap proposition recognizing both project/1 and project/2.
Atomic grant applicability, scope, availability, consumption, and approval issuance strengthen the grant-operations runtime's bounded grant-derived approval/application behavior.
The atomic grant issuance rules strengthen the common mutation substrate's exact-proposal-bound grant-derived approval semantics.

Installer tests for drift, transport, incompatibility, unknown roots, and post-activation failure preserving project files or restoring the prior install strengthen the installer-runner failure-preservation contract.

Admission tests requiring independent admission authority and rejecting reconciliation recommendation as admission authority strengthen the Steward-authorization contract's independent reconciliation/admission scopes.
The accepted-release greenfield retest's idempotent bootstrap and no-authority/no-canonical-state outcome strengthen the bootstrap test proposition.
The greenfield bootstrap retest creating no authority or canonical state strengthens the orchestrator bootstrap authority boundary.
The operator-management workflow's independent R5 conformance run strengthens the operator-management test proposition around protected root transfer behavior.
The Steward-authorization contract's exact human-operator approval requirement strengthens the broader independent scoped-authority proposition.
The bounded-authority-grant design's mandatory materiality pauses strengthens the Human-to-Agent rule that a grant cannot waive required materiality acknowledgement.
Grant-derived approval requirements for immediate revalidation and independent apply-time validation strengthen the common mutation substrate's exact proposal/approval semantics.

Production-invocation tests for missing evidence, digest mismatch, output collision, and unregistered provenance strengthen the ingestion operation's fail-closed bounded-evidence preparation boundary.

The frozen extraction baseline's explicit preservation of rgp/1 semantics with no semantic change authorized strengthens the orchestrator contract's rule that package-owned RGP/PEMS/COVE protocols may not be reinterpreted by consumers.
The reconciliation workflow's independent R12 conformance run strengthens the reconciliation test record describing fail-closed and immutable-disposition behavior.
Rupi authority-flow tests proving targets are never inferred and protected mutations require separate ceremonies strengthen the orchestrator initial-operator setup boundary.

Rupi authority-flow tests proving authority setup creates no activation or semantic state strengthen the operator-registry contract's separation of administrative operator identity from semantic/admission authority.
The v0.5.2 release-status PASS with exact source commit, content identity, and transport digest strengthens the P8 immutable release-baseline proposition.
The Human-to-Agent/workflow requirement that valid materiality pauses interrupt consequential continuation strengthens the rule that grants cannot waive required materiality acknowledgement.
Role-registry tests proving default Steward presence creates no authority strengthen the Steward-authorization contract's rule that registration alone never grants a scope.
The bootstrap runtime's minimal project-owned directory creation and fail-closed conflict handling strengthen the bootstrap test proposition.
The bootstrap runtime's project-state creation and unsupported-configuration rejection strengthen the project-bootstrap compatibility proposition.
Keeping proposal creation, approval creation, and application as distinct operations strengthens the common mutation substrate's exact proposal/approval separation.
The CLI runtime's dispatch through existing runtime primitives strengthens the workflow rule that adapter/orchestration surfaces do not themselves grant downstream authority.
The Extraction Parity workflow's RGP fixture-parity execution strengthens the fixture test runner proposition.
The Phase 0 baseline's five materially different real-project cases strengthen the evaluation corpus proposition preserving exact Phase-1 inputs for repeatable comparison.
The Phase-1 closeout's 15 independent validator-passing runs across five cases strengthens the evaluation corpus's role as a stable repeated-run reference.
